 Lindstrom shooting: Suspect and 1 other dead; Minnesota BCA investigating
 Sabrina Salguero Del Cid KSTP 
 --> 
 Lindstrom shooting latest
 Authorities said there is no longer a threat to the public after a large law enforcement response Saturday in a Lindstrom neighborhood.
 In an update from the Chisago County Sheriff’s Office, it was announced the suspect in Saturday morning’s shooting incident had been killed by law enforcement and that one “involved individual” had died while another was taken to a trauma center for treatment.
 According to the Chisago County Sheriff’s Office, deputies and several other law enforcement agencies responded at about 11 a.m. to a report of an active shooter at a residence off Stacy Trail.
 Law enforcement reportedly made contact with the suspect, which eventually led to the suspect’s death. 
 Chisago County Sheriff’s Office Captain Dereck Anklan provided a brief statement on behalf of the sheriff’s office regarding what had transpired.
 “At approximately 11 o’clock this morning, the Chisago County Sheriff’s Office began receiving 911 calls regarding shots being fired at a residence near the 12,000th block of Stacy Trail,” Captain Anklan read. “Multiple law enforcement agencies responded, and the suspect was ultimately shot by law enforcement. The suspect is deceased and there is no threat to the public.”
 Captain Anklan also said, “There are two additional involved individuals. One is deceased, and one was transported to a regional trauma center.”
 Anklan did not state how the “involved individuals” were connected to the incident. 
 No law enforcement officers were injured.
 According to Captain Anklan, the Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension is investigating the officer-involved shooting and will provide further information as the investigation continues. 
 This is a developing story; check back for updates.
